decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the mansard roof extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building and the materials used in the construction of the external surfaces of the rear extension hereby approved shall match those specified on the submitted application form; namely rendered block work on the walls, powder coated aluminium fenestration and asphalt roofing unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Design and Access Statement, SH2/CH, SH2/CH/1250, SH2/CH/500AE, SH2/CHSH2/CH/10, SH2/CH/11, SH2/CH/12, SH2/CH/112 PA, SH2/CH/13, SH2/CH/113 PA, SH2/CH/14, SH2/CH/114 PA, SH2/CH/15 received 20/01/2011, Flood Risk Assessment received 21/03/2011 and SH2/CH/110 PA, SH2/CH/111 PA and SH2/CH/115 PA received 11/05/2011)  therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension and rear mansard roof extension to the house.
